values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; campsites can be booked for today, and 1-night campsite stays are allowed. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Some campsites, the bathrooms and the concession stand close after Labor Day; call ahead. Rustic cabins need 2 nights all season.
